title: Battle of Rocoux
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Rocoux", at revision 1370587617, opens: "The Battle of Rocoux took place on 11 October 1746 during the War of the Austrian Succession, near Rocourt, Liège in Belgium. It was fought between a French army under Marshal Saxe and a combined British, Dutch, German and Austrian force led by Charles of Lorraine, Earl Ligonier and Prince Waldeck." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q32493, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle during the War of the Austrian Succession, result was French victory". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
